item.title: Text Message Meme About Falling In Love And Caging Your Enemies Goes Viral On X, Instagram
item.description: Aww So Cute But Who Is In the Cage is an exploitable text message / DM exchange meme where one person sends another a drawing of two stick figures in love standing between a person in a cage and a house, the sender on the right asking, "Who is in the cage?" and the sender on the left responding with a name. item.title: 'John is Kill' Is 14 Years Old Today
item.description: “John is Kill” refers to a copypasta story that is meant to survey what people were doing at the time of the Beatles singer-songwriter John Lennon’s death on December 8th, 1980. The story, which is marked by improper English grammar and spelling errors, has inspired a number of variations featuring other deceased celebrities and musicians in substitute of the English rock star. In December 2019, "Club Pengiun Is Kil" version of the copypasta gained popularity.

item.title: The Infamous Reddit Creepypasta Called 'The Lamp Story' Appeared On The Site 14 Years Ago Today
item.description: The Reddit Lamp Story refers to a creepypasta that originated on Reddit. In 2012, Redditor /u/temptotosssoon recounted an experience where he imagined that he lived an entirely different life in the moments after he sustained a head injury, only shaking out of his dream when he became enraptured by a lamp in his living room. The story has been reposted on Reddit's /r/Glitch as well as the Creepypasta Wiki, having a resurgence on TikTok in 2023.

item.title: Nine Years Ago, Obama Awarded Himself A Medal
item.description: Obama Awards Obama a Medal refers to a humorous photoshop of an award ceremony photograph in which the former United States President Barack Obama awards the Presidential Medal of Freedom to himself. Online, the image has been used in memes about the former president and circulated as a reaction.
